Imaging review workspace

Real visual review, not simulated diagnosis.

Review exported, de-identified medical images locally, then optionally request an AI-assisted visual review from a configured OpenAI or Gemini provider. The report preserves uncertainty and never substitutes for clinical interpretation.

Clinical boundary.Do not upload identifiable patient images. This is not a medical device, radiology report, or treatment recommendation.

No image selected

PNG · JPEG · WebP · up to 25 MB

View

Drag to pan. Hover the image for pixel intensity.

Choose a de-identified image

Local tools run in your browser; provider review is opt-in. Drag & drop works too.

Technical image quality

Load an image to compute local technical metrics.

Technical image-quality metrics — not clinical measurements. Computed locally from pixel statistics.

AI-assisted visual review

Powered analysis, not faked diagnosis.

Checking providers...

Submit only after confirming de-identification. Never use for emergency, diagnostic, or treatment decisions.

Capabilities

The report can describe visible image characteristics, technical quality, and limitations. It cannot replace a radiologist, analyze full DICOM studies, or validate disease findings.

Explore de-identified teaching data
Ask about this image

Questions answered against the loaded image.

Sends the currently loaded image to the configured provider with your question, under the same de-identification consent as analysis. Answers are AI-assisted observations about the visible image only — not a diagnosis, radiology report, or treatment recommendation. Nothing is stored by Nephro.

No questions yet. Try a suggested question or type your own.

Structured checklist

Ultrasound

What to look for in this modality. Check off what you observe — the list stays in your browser and never leaves it.

Review report

Generate a review document from the current workspace.

Combines the AI report with your confirmed / edited / rejected findings, checklist selections, pixel measurements and technical quality metrics, plus the AI-assistance notice. A working document for review by a qualified clinician — not a diagnosis.

Needs an AI report, checklist selections, or measurements/annotations.

Not a medical device. This tool implements published equations exactly as specified and shows its working. It does not diagnose, and it does not replace clinical judgement. Every result must be interpreted by a qualified clinician in the context of the individual patient.

Imaging review workspace

Real visual review, not simulated diagnosis.

Review exported, de-identified medical images locally, then optionally request an AI-assisted visual review from a configured OpenAI or Gemini provider. The report preserves uncertainty and never substitutes for clinical interpretation.

Clinical boundary.Do not upload identifiable patient images. This is not a medical device, radiology report, or treatment recommendation.

No image selected

PNG · JPEG · WebP · up to 25 MB

View
Annotate
Measure

Drag to pan. Hover the image for pixel intensity.

Choose a de-identified image

Local tools run in your browser; provider review is opt-in. Drag & drop works too.

Hover for pixel intensity

Local controls
Brightness100%
Contrast100%
Local file facts
Dimensions
—
Mean luminance
—
Modality
Ultrasound
Processing state
Checking providers
Storage
This browser
Format
—
Technical image quality

Load an image to compute local technical metrics.

Technical image-quality metrics — not clinical measurements. Computed locally from pixel statistics.

AI-assisted visual review

Powered analysis, not faked diagnosis.

Checking providers...

Submit only after confirming de-identification. Never use for emergency, diagnostic, or treatment decisions.

Capabilities

The report can describe visible image characteristics, technical quality, and limitations. It cannot replace a radiologist, analyze full DICOM studies, or validate disease findings.

Explore de-identified teaching data
Ask about this image

Questions answered against the loaded image.

Sends the currently loaded image to the configured provider with your question, under the same de-identification consent as analysis. Answers are AI-assisted observations about the visible image only — not a diagnosis, radiology report, or treatment recommendation. Nothing is stored by Nephro.

No questions yet. Try a suggested question or type your own.

Structured checklist

Ultrasound

What to look for in this modality. Check off what you observe — the list stays in your browser and never leaves it.

Review report

Generate a review document from the current workspace.

Combines the AI report with your confirmed / edited / rejected findings, checklist selections, pixel measurements and technical quality metrics, plus the AI-assistance notice. A working document for review by a qualified clinician — not a diagnosis.

Needs an AI report, checklist selections, or measurements/annotations.

Not a medical device. This tool implements published equations exactly as specified and shows its working. It does not diagnose, and it does not replace clinical judgement. Every result must be interpreted by a qualified clinician in the context of the individual patient.
